description: Create a short link for a URL. Works without an API key (anonymous links expire and are not saved to an account). When a short link is followed, Linkonda counts the click and records nothing about the visitor: no IP address, location, device data or referrer. Use when the user wants a short or shareable URL, or a link for a QR code.

expiresInDays.description: Optional. The link stops redirecting after this many days: it then answers 410 Gone, stays on the account, and its short URL is never reused. Requires a Pro or Enterprise plan. Omit it on other plans: links made with an API key then don't expire, and anonymous links expire after the anonymous lifetime (check_quota shows it).

slug.description: Don't set this. Custom short codes are not available on any plan, and the API refuses a request that sets slug. Omit it to get a generated short code.

url.description: The destination URL to shorten. Must be absolute, e.g. https://example.com/page

name: shorten_link
title: Shorten a URL
